reference_policy: A citation describes the published family or model; it does not independently certify formula-level identity.

aitken_backtracking.citation: Sidi, Practical Extrapolation Methods, Cambridge University Press (2003)
aitken_backtracking.implementation_note: Local backtracking to locate a nonsingular triple; not a named historical algorithm.

aitken_delta2.citation: Sidi, Practical Extrapolation Methods, Cambridge University Press (2003)
aitken_delta2.implementation_note: Aitken Delta^2 expression; exact triple window.

anderson.citation: Walker & Ni, Anderson Acceleration for Fixed-Point Iterations, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 49 (2011)
anderson.locator: fixed-point acceleration background; scalar observed-pair variant here
anderson.implementation_note: Scalar observed-pair extrapolation, not a full fixed-point function Anderson solver.

brezinski_e.citation: Fdil, Some results on convergence acceleration for the E-algorithm, Applicationes Mathematicae 24(4) (1997)
brezinski_e.implementation_note: Requires explicit auxiliary/error basis; compare separately from black-box methods.

brezinski_theta.implementation_note: Theta recurrence; current lower-order fallback is implementation policy.

chang_wynn.citation: Chang, He, Hu, Sun & Weniger, Construction of New Generalizations of Wynn's Epsilon and Rho Algorithm (2019)
chang_wynn.implementation_note: Chang et al. generalization; different input budget from ordinary Wynn epsilon.

cvz_2a.citation: Cohen, Rodriguez Villegas & Zagier, Convergence Acceleration of Alternating Series, Experimental Mathematics 9 (2000), 3-12

cvz_2b.citation: Cohen, Rodriguez Villegas & Zagier, Convergence Acceleration of Alternating Series, Experimental Mathematics 9 (2000), 3-12

cvz_chebyshev.citation: Cohen, Rodriguez Villegas & Zagier, Convergence Acceleration of Alternating Series, Experimental Mathematics 9 (2000), 3-12

drummond.implementation_note: Difference-quotient scheme with configurable remainder choice.

euler_alternating.implementation_note: Alternating-series Euler transformation; restricted regularity assumptions.

ford_sidi.citation: Ford & Sidi, An algorithm for a generalization of the Richardson extrapolation process, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 24 (1987), 1212-1232
ford_sidi.locator: W^(m) recursion and generalized Richardson-type elimination
ford_sidi.implementation_note: Generalized elimination using a Levin error basis; verify exact column-basis mapping per example.

ford_sidi_dm_wm.citation: Ford & Sidi, An algorithm for a generalization of the Richardson extrapolation process, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 24 (1987), 1212-1232
ford_sidi_dm_wm.implementation_note: Ford-Sidi d example via W^(m) recursion.

ford_sidi_wm.citation: Ford & Sidi, An algorithm for a generalization of the Richardson extrapolation process, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 24 (1987), 1212-1232

homeier_f.implementation_note: F construction per the cited Homeier formulas.

homeier_h.implementation_note: H construction per the cited Homeier formulas.

homeier_pj.implementation_note: pJ variant; special p=2 numerical pathway.

iterated_aitken.citation: Weniger, Nonlinear Sequence Transformations (1989 dissertation; 2003 arXiv version)
iterated_aitken.implementation_note: Repeated Delta^2 transform; not identical to Shanks of the same order.

levin.citation: Levin, Development of non-linear transformations for improving convergence of sequences, Int. J. Comput. Math. 3 (1973)
levin.implementation_note: Current implementation has configurable remainder estimates and beta.

levin_power_remainder.citation: Levin, Development of non-linear transformations for improving convergence of sequences, Int. J. Comput. Math. 3 (1973)
levin_power_remainder.implementation_note: Independent power-model collocation with variable exponent; do not attribute generalized formula to Levin.

levin_sidi_m.citation: Weniger, Nonlinear Sequence Transformations (1989 dissertation; 2003 arXiv version)
levin_sidi_m.implementation_note: Historical C++ identifier; factorial Weniger M formula, not an independent Sidi algorithm.

levin_sidi_s.locator: sections 6.3.3 and 19.3 (Sidi S; naming comparison still unresolved)
levin_sidi_s.implementation_note: EXPLICIT WARNING: implementation is factorial Weniger S-type quotient; same formula as weniger at equal parameters. Verify exact Sidi ch.19 formula before claiming this identifier identifies Sidi S; see also https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0306302.

lubkin_w.implementation_note: W transform; equivalent theta_2 rational expression in this implementation.

osada_generalized_rho.citation: Osada, A convergence acceleration method for some logarithmically convergent sequences, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 27 (1990), 178-189
osada_generalized_rho.implementation_note: Generalized rho, including parameter specialization to classical rho.

osada_rho_safe.citation: Osada, A convergence acceleration method for some logarithmically convergent sequences, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 27 (1990), 178-189
osada_rho_safe.implementation_note: Published generalized rho recurrence plus local last-valid-row recovery.

osada_rho_theta_estimated.citation: Osada, A convergence acceleration method for some logarithmically convergent sequences, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 27 (1990), 178-189
osada_rho_theta_estimated.implementation_note: Two-stage exponent estimate is NOT literal published automatic algorithm (6.1).

overholt.implementation_note: Overholt transformation; check window indexing against original.

richardson.implementation_note: Specialized Romberg-style error grid with ratio 1/4; not generic Richardson.

shanks.citation: Weniger, Nonlinear Sequence Transformations (1989 dissertation; 2003 arXiv version)
shanks.implementation_note: Hankel determinant Shanks transformation; independently see DLMF 3.9(iv).

sidi_d_m.citation: Sidi, Practical Extrapolation Methods: Theory and Applications (2003)
sidi_d_m.implementation_note: Direct d^(m) defining linear system, not optimized W^(m).

sidi_d_m_e_recursive.citation: Sidi, Practical Extrapolation Methods: Theory and Applications (2003)
sidi_d_m_e_recursive.implementation_note: Alternative E-recursive elimination for the same d^(m) system; not a new method.

sidi_dm_strided.citation: Sidi, Practical Extrapolation Methods: Theory and Applications (2003)
sidi_dm_strided.implementation_note: Nonuniform R_l sampling extension of the defining d^(m) system.

weniger.citation: Weniger, Nonlinear Sequence Transformations (1989 dissertation; 2003 arXiv version)
weniger.implementation_note: Factorial Levin-type transform; distinct parameter/remainder choices do not imply distinct methods.

weniger_fractional_factorial.citation: Weniger, Nonlinear Sequence Transformations (1989 dissertation; 2003 arXiv version)
weniger_fractional_factorial.implementation_note: Fractional step in inverse-factorial basis is local generalization, not published Weniger formula.

weniger_m.citation: Weniger, Nonlinear Sequence Transformations (1989 dissertation; 2003 arXiv version)
weniger_m.implementation_note: Published-name alias for legacy levin_sidi_m; not an independent algorithm.

wynn_epsilon.citation: Wynn, On a device for computing the e_m(S_n) transformation, MTAC 10 (1956), 91-96
wynn_epsilon.implementation_note: Wynn epsilon recursive table; local singularity fallback policy is separate.

wynn_epsilon_adaptive.citation: Wynn, On a device for computing the e_m(S_n) transformation, MTAC 10 (1956), 91-96
wynn_epsilon_adaptive.implementation_note: Adaptive selection of available even columns is local stability policy.

wynn_epsilon_fixed.citation: Wynn, On a device for computing the e_m(S_n) transformation, MTAC 10 (1956), 91-96
wynn_epsilon_fixed.implementation_note: Fixed even-column/window evaluator; not an additional mathematical transformation.

wynn_rho.implementation_note: Wynn rho recursion with configurable interpolation node grid.
